reapack.name: Volca Drum Panel.jsfx
reapack.desc: Volca Drum Panel (Korg volca drum editor)

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Select split into SRC / MOD.T / EG.T rows. Two looks (Classic / Sleeve) + 14 color themes. Test hit and Q (pitch quantize, CC 53) per part. Tooltips. Notes on channel 11-16 play parts melodically. FILT locked for ROLL by default.

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Classic look: part titles = small PART label + big number, so they fit at any window size (were cut to "P...").

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Fix: switching Q (pitch quantize) off now always brings the part back to its PITCH value (also via undo / automation).

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Works together with the new Volca Drum Sequencer (p-locks, kit per pattern, LINK sends locks to both layers). AUTO SEND: the whole kit goes out once after a project load (toggle next to SEND ALL, on by default). Sound files: SAVE / LOAD / RENAME / DELETE a part in the SOUND menu (save, rename, delete need the action "Volca listener (start)"). Kit actions: Volca kit (save) / (kit +) / (kit -) / (send all), kit names in the display. UNDO also takes back a kit load and MORPH. Sends are paced by time. Fixes: typed values time out, locks after a sample-rate change, sound names starting with # ! > <. Installs the scripts too (Actions list: "Volca ...").

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Values in real units, measured on a volca drum: LEVEL in dB, ATTACK / RELEASE in ms, PITCH in Hz + nearest note and cents (sine / saw; Q on shows QPI), rise-fall MOD / RATE as sweep in semitones / ms. Cells show the number with a small unit, the display the long form. Noise pitch, OSC / RND mod and the mix rows stay 0-127. Sleeve look: Q and LINK stay visible when on in the selected part.

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: SMART roll: RANDOM now has a kind (KICK, SNARE, CLAP, HAT, METAL, PERC, BASS, MICRO, MIX) and SMART / WILD. SMART rolls a sound of that kind inside its useful ranges (measured on a volca drum); MIX on KIT rolls a whole drum kit; low AMOUNT stays close to the current sound. WILD = the old full-range roll. Two new parameters: Rnd Mode, Rnd Kind. SOUND menu: sounds that share their first word are grouped in submenus (also in the Volca sound actions). Alt+click = default on every bar, AMOUNT and MORPH (double-click still works). ATTACK / RELEASE times no longer show "~": all EG types have the same length.

reapack.name: Volca Drum Sequencer.jsfx
reapack.desc: Volca Drum Sequencer (step sequencer for the Korg volca drum)

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Fix: pitch locks only on lanes with PIT on. On PIT-off lanes they are blocked and not sent, and the PITCH tab can't be painted there.

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: P-lock cells, the paint display and the step menu show LEVEL, ATTACK, RELEASE, PITCH, MOD and RATE locks in real units (dB, ms, note / Hz, semitones), like the panel. Needs the panel 2.1+ on the track.

version.author: NH4X
version.changelog: Right-click lists on HUMANIZE, EUCLID HITS, GEN AMOUNT, INTENSITY, ACCENT amount, BPM, the length strip and the P-LOCK parameter field. Alt+click = default on GEN AMOUNT / WHAT, EVOLVE CHANGES, BPM and the length strip; double-click INTENSITY = 50 %. CAL: right-click opens a menu (no silent reset), Alt+click = 0 ms. Fix: Alt+click on a step sets the lane length only in STEPS; in the value tabs Alt paints the default again. ATTACK / RELEASE locks no longer show "~".
